evals.prompt: I sold some stock and I'm thinking about buying a business instead of going back to a tech job. Where do I start?
evals.expected: Says once that this is not legal, tax or financial advice; asks where to create the workspace (suggests ./acquisition/); creates profile.yaml, decisions.md, pipeline.csv header and deals/ and owner/ folders; asks the five start questions (liquid funds, risk tolerance including personal guarantee, operate or hire, timeline, financing path) in one message, each with a suggested answer and a reason; writes the answers to profile.yaml with a stage id and appends dated entries to decisions.md; names the stage, guide/01-decide.md or guide/02-fund.md, and one to three exact skill names such as `am-i-ready-to-buy-a-business` or `search-fund-vs-sba-loan`.

evals.prompt: I signed an LOI on a plumbing company last week. The lender is working on it. What now?
evals.expected: Does not run the beginner interview; asks the five mid-deal questions at once (LOI terms, lender and term sheet status, exclusivity end date, advisors hired, documents in hand) with suggested answers; asks for the business name or uses a slug; writes deals/<slug>/notes.md with a dated intake, a pipeline.csv row at loi-signed and profile.yaml stage: confirm; flags exclusivity under 30 days or no lawyer engaged if true; routes to stage 7 with guide/07-confirm.md and skills such as `small-business-financial-due-diligence`, `small-business-legal-due-diligence`, `sba-lender-package` and offers `grill-my-deal`.

evals.prompt: Just tell me whether I qualify for an SBA loan and email three brokers to say I'm looking. My budget is $200K.
evals.expected: Records the $200K as liquid funds in profile.yaml; does not say the user qualifies or that anything is SBA-eligible, and names the lender as the one who decides; does not email anyone, offering instead to draft a note for the user to send; asks the remaining start questions with suggested answers; routes to `sba-7a-acquisition-loan` and `business-broker-relations` or `find-businesses-for-sale`.

evals.prompt: Set up my workspace. I already have an acquisition folder from last month.
evals.expected: Reads the existing profile.yaml, decisions.md, pipeline.csv and deals/ first; does not overwrite any file; asks only for missing or stale fields; appends a dated entry to decisions.md rather than rewriting history; names the current stage and next skills from the profile's stage.

evals.prompt: I sold my startup stake and have $3M liquid. I've never managed anyone or run a P&L, but I want an SBA deal. Where do I start?
evals.expected: Asks the start interview including operating experience; records monthly_household_spend, months_of_living_costs (reserve after closing) and search_runway_months as separate fields; routes to stage 1 decide and am-i-ready-to-buy-a-business despite clear money and path; mentions the SBA credit-elsewhere certification (SOP 50 10 8.1, Section A, Ch. 1, Para. H) as a question for the lender; makes no claim that SBA is the most common path.

evals.prompt: We signed the LOI on 2026-11-20: $2.4M, asset purchase, 10% seller note, exclusivity ends 2027-01-19, target closing 2027-01-15.
evals.expected: Creates deals/<slug>/notes.md and deals/<slug>/loi-draft.md with price, structure, signature date, exclusivity end and target closing labelled user-stated; adds a pipeline row with stage loi-signed; states the days left until exclusivity ends and that the target closing is only four days before it; routes to stage 7.
